messages:
jamal: quick q — noticed aggressive probe traffic from prefix-prober is forcing eviction churn in shared kv cache. experiment: set grace_period_ms=2000 reduced churn but increased memory hold. Anyone else hit this?
priya: saw similar on canary. probes do short-lived pins then return, causing lease allocator to mark hot & then evict. Not ideal.
sarah: can you paste logs? suspect race between probe ack and lease expiry.
jamal: pasted logs: ```INFO probe for prefix pfx123 pinned lease id=lk23 ttl=1000ms; RELEASE at +1s; eviction triggered at +1.1s```
leo: hmm looks like probe pin duration < eviction hysteresis. We should make probes opt-in for shared pools or make probe pins non-counting (soft pins).
ops-bot: deploy scheduled by jamal for kv-runtime/probe-tweak at 10:15pm :rocket:
priya: alternative: add 'probe_coalesce' window to batch probes for same prefix for N ms, so single pin covers multiple probes.
sarah: tradeoffs: coalesce reduces churn but increases probe latency and possibly misses cold-start detection.
jamal: data: 48h canary — coalesce=50ms reduced evictions 28% but 95th probe latency +12ms. acceptable?
leo: propose 2-prong: 1) make probe pins 'transient' w/o bumping eviction score, but still refresh kv cache entry; 2) add small probe_coalesce default 25ms.
priya: how do we implement 'transient' pins safely? need read-after-write correctness for in-flight writes.
sarah: impl sketch: transient pins increment ephemeral counter not visible to eviction LRU weights; if an actual request later promotes to permanent pin, we merge counts atomically. Need atomicity across shards.
leo: I'll write a spike: shard-local ephemeral counters + sequencer compare-and-swap on promotion. should be low racy.
jamal: can we get a quick RFC follow-up? I'll gather perf numbers and propose default values. tagging @sarah @leo @priya
priya: ack, will sketch canary config and test harness.
jamal: thanks. if ops-bot sees more than 10% eviction delta during canary auto-rollback?
ops-bot: canary monitors: eviction-rate, probe-latency. will rollback if eviction_rate increases by >10% vs baseline.
sarah: leaving note — this is a correctness-adjacent change, add unit tests for RA-write after transient pin promotion. also add metrics 'transient_promotions'
jamal: :thumbsup:
